clue.text: Small bird that is trapped, initially, by rodent

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of the word trapped just before it

parts.note: that and it are interchangeable pronouns, as in 'that is it'
a mouse is a small rodent

explanation.surface: A little bird finds itself caught at first by a mouse.
explanation.definitionFit: The titmouse is the fuller old name for the tit, a small songbird of woods and gardens.

clue.text: Craft set out, upholding condition for trade

annotationWithheld.why: Craft set out, upholding condition for trade (7): the only parse needs 'upholding' to be both the reversal indicator (IF going up) and the container indicator, one word doing two jobs
annotationWithheld.clue: Craft set out, upholding condition for trade

clue.text: Starts from three or eight, as low digit

indicators.note: Starts from asks for the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: Counting from three or eight as the lowest number.
explanation.walkthrough: 'digit' suggests a number, but it is a toe, the digit on the foot, hence 'low'.
explanation.definitionFit: A toe is a digit of the foot, the lowest of the body's digits.

clue.text: Girl covers area for putting colour

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece that covers sits above, so it comes first

parts.note: Olive is a girl's name
a golf green is where players putt

explanation.surface: A girl spreads paint over a surface to apply some colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Olive green is a dull yellowish-green shade like that of unripe olives.

clue.text: Deadly offence of tropical American native

definitions.meaning: one of the seven deadly sins, namely laziness
a slow tree-dwelling mammal of Central and South American forests

explanation.definitionFit: Sloth is the deadly sin of idleness and also the slow-moving mammal of South American rainforests.

clue.text: Old instrument of stone lined with wood

indicators.note: a thing lined with something has that material on its inside, so the second piece goes within the first

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for stone, the British unit of weight of 14 pounds
pine is a common softwood timber

explanation.surface: An antique instrument made of stone with a wooden lining.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinet is a small harpsichord-type keyboard instrument of the 17th and 18th centuries.

clue.text: Alexander's predecessor as religious leader, successor as poet

definitions.meaning: in the title of a pontiff named Alexander, the title word comes before the name
the 18th-century English poet Alexander has his surname coming after his first name

explanation.definitionFit: Several popes took the name Alexander, and Alexander Pope was the English poet of The Rape of the Lock.

clue.text: Refine check as redesigned for cloth square

indicators.note: redesigned means given a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Improving a checked pattern by reworking it for a square of fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: A neckerchief is a square of cloth worn knotted round the neck.

clue.text: Travel permit for one arriving with two others

parts.note: a trip is a journey
let means allow or permit

explanation.surface: A travel pass for someone turning up with two companions.
explanation.definitionFit: A triplet is one of three children born together at a single birth.

clue.text: Doctor concealing nothing about inferior

indicators.note: concealing means hiding something inside, so the next piece goes within

parts.note: a medic is a doctor
O, the figure zero, stands for nothing
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A doctor hiding nothing about a poor standard.
explanation.definitionFit: Mediocre means of only moderate or poor quality, second-rate.

clue.text: Explorer's previous image changed over centuries

indicators.note: over means covering or across, so the rearranged letters lie over and around the next piece
changed tells us the letters of the words before it are put in a new order

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so two centuries give CC

explanation.surface: An explorer's former reputation has been altered over the centuries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Explorer's' reads as 'the explorer is', so its 's is a link to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Amerigo Vespucci was the Florentine navigator after whom the Americas were named.

clue.text: Measure of warmth fine hearth can produce

indicators.note: can produce tells us the given letters may be made into something else by rearrangement

explanation.surface: A good fireside can give off a measurable heat.
explanation.definitionFit: Fahrenheit is the temperature scale, a way of measuring how hot something is.

clue.text: Pay attention about time little brother gets distressed

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the listening word goes round the other pieces

parts.note: to hearken is to listen or pay attention
bro is a short form of brother

explanation.surface: Listen to how an upset little brother is behaving.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartbroken means overwhelmed with grief or distress.

clue.text: Put cards on table for business arrangement

definitions.meaning: to hand out cards to the players at the start of a game
an agreement or bargain struck in trade

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both distributing cards in a game and a commercial agreement or bargain.

clue.text: Starts to ask for part of test

parts.note: to beg is to ask for
an innings is a team's turn at batting, a division of a cricket Test match

explanation.surface: Beginning to request part of an exam.
explanation.walkthrough: A Test is an international cricket match, played over several innings; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Beginnings are starts or origins of things.

clue.text: Cleaned what's black on surface

definitions.meaning: did housework, as a charwoman does
scorched so the outside is blackened

explanation.walkthrough: A char or charwoman is a British term for a cleaner, hence the verb to char.
explanation.definitionFit: To char is British for doing paid cleaning, and charring also means burning the surface black.

clue.text: Doctor admitting possible cause of accidental death

parts.note: owning, as in owning up, means admitting

explanation.surface: A doctor confessing what may have caused an accidental death.
explanation.definitionFit: Drowning, death from water in the lungs, is a common accidental death.

clue.text: Boasted pretty short hair style

parts.note: crew is a past tense of crow, to boast

indicators.note: short tells us the word is cut by its final letter

parts.note: cute means pretty

explanation.surface: Someone bragged about their rather brief haircut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pretty short' looks like 'quite short', but 'pretty' is CUTE, shortened.
explanation.definitionFit: A crew cut is a very short, bristly men's haircut.

clue.text: Red coat refashioned in 30's style

indicators.note: refashioned means made over in a new shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A red coat has been restyled in the manner of the 1930s.
explanation.definitionFit: Art deco is the geometric decorative style that flourished in the 1920s and 1930s.

clue.text: Attack a saint, grabbing Paul, originally

indicators.note: grabbing means seizing and holding, so the saint's letters go round the next piece

parts.note: the apostle Paul was originally called Saul of Tarsus

explanation.surface: An attack on a saint involves seizing Paul at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' tempts you to take the first letter P, but it means Paul's original name, SAUL.
explanation.definitionFit: An assault is a violent attack.

clue.text: Morally instructs wicked if I, especially, take part

indicators.note: take part tells us only a portion of the run of words is used, a stretch inside them

explanation.surface: Someone corrects the wicked, especially if they themselves get involved.
explanation.definitionFit: To edify is to improve someone morally or intellectually by instruction.

clue.text: Hurried outside to set out spread

indicators.note: outside means placed around, so the hurrying word wraps the other piece

parts.note: sped means hurried
to lay is to set out, as in laying a table

explanation.surface: Someone rushed out to lay things wide apart.
explanation.definitionFit: Splayed means spread out or apart, as of fingers or legs.

clue.text: Island's second rescue craft

parts.note: Noah's ark was the vessel that saved the animals from the flood

explanation.surface: An island's spare lifeboat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Island's' reads as 'the island is'. Sark is one of the Channel Islands.
explanation.definitionFit: Sark is a small island in the Channel Islands, between Guernsey and Jersey.

clue.text: Fluctuating temperature with kind of 'flu, without incident

parts.note: something fluctuating is uneven, not steady

indicators.note: kind of suggests a variant form, so the short word is rearranged

parts.note: the old shortened spelling of influenza, used as written

explanation.surface: A patient's temperature goes up and down with a type of influenza, though nothing else happens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kind of' turns FLU into FUL to finish the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Uneventful means quiet and calm, with nothing happening.

clue.text: Declare support with very pained expression

parts.note: ouch is a cry of pain

explanation.surface: Someone states their backing with a look of real suffering.
explanation.definitionFit: To vouch is to declare one's support or guarantee for someone.

clue.text: Places in Rome for a meeting

indicators.note: meeting means coming together, so the two small words before it join up into a single word

explanation.surface: Locations in Rome where people could gather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'meeting' looks like the Roman forum's purpose but is what tells you to run the two words together; the Latin plural of forum is the entry.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin plural of forum names the open squares of ancient Roman towns.

clue.text: Dark horse that may be last in Derby, literally

definitions.meaning: a person or entrant of whom little is known

definitions.text: that may be last in Derby, literally
definitions.meaning: the last letter of Derby is Y, which in algebra stands for an unknown value

explanation.walkthrough: The Derby is a famous English horse race at Epsom, so the surface pictures an outsider finishing last.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark horse is someone whose abilities nobody knows; in algebra x or y is a value to be found.

clue.text: In short, the state of Chicago is bad

indicators.note: In short calls for the abbreviated form of the state name

parts.note: Chicago is in Illinois

explanation.surface: To sum up, Chicago is in a sorry state.
explanation.walkthrough: ILL is the standard abbreviation of Illinois.
explanation.definitionFit: Ill means bad, as in ill effects or ill will.

clue.text: Means to preserve artefact, finally, of ancient civilization

indicators.note: finally points at the closing letter of artefact

parts.note: Incan means belonging to the Inca civilization of ancient Peru

explanation.surface: A method of preserving an artefact from a lost people.
explanation.definitionFit: A tin can is a sealed metal container used to keep food from spoiling.

clue.text: Indicated foul in game played first

parts.note: whist is a card game
in cards, a player who led played the first card of the trick

explanation.surface: A referee signalled an infringement in a match that went first.
explanation.definitionFit: A referee who whistled blew to signal that a foul had been committed.
